info.title: D&D Beyond Character API
info.description: A browser-owned API on IPv4 loopback for the remembered character selected in the extension. Windows x64, desktop Chrome and Brave. Read the dynamic URL and local bearer from %LOCALAPPDATA%/TabletopVR/character-bridge/v2/http.json. D&D Beyond credentials never leave the browser. Any supported character suffix can use /v1/character or /v1/characters/{characterId}. Writes are never automatically retried. Unknown outcomes require a fresh read before deciding on another action.

port.description: Load the actual port from the per-user http.json discovery file.

CharacterDocument.description: Unmodified D&D Beyond v5 character data, including inventory, classes, spells, actions, notes, counters and source definitions. DDB controls this upstream schema.

response.description: Upstream status and JSON response; generic acknowledgement is not read-back verification.

path.description: Relative character-service path or HTTPS URL on character-service.dndbeyond.com or character-service-scds.dndbeyond.com only. Redirects and custom headers are not supported.

body.description: JSON forwarded to DDB. Standard mutation objects default characterId to the route character; other/nested identifiers must refer to the intended character.
